study.question: After target-relation tokenization, does projecting relation timing O independently of the full rank/content moment M improve the representation beyond an equally parameterized duplicate M path?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: existing code can only add one shared projection A*M=A*W+A*O, tying the maps of within-relation weighted-content order W and relation-placement O. In g0-r0006-full_replay macro AUC is 0.8283262735 versus 0.8281966383 for W, 0.8278706981 for O and 0.8275704846 for zero. These one-seed results are consistent with complementary signals, not evidence of optimal mixing or significance. Add B*O to A*M so W and O can have distinct maps while preserving the original initial predictor. O is the unweighted mean matched rank times the DIN-weighted content sum, not elapsed time or a pure behavior-frequency signal. W includes learned activation variation. Broader trajectory: relation content/count tokenization helped (0.8275704846 versus replica 0.8197867255); atomic fields did not beat replicas (0.8195094317 versus 0.8197867255); all three feedback-count extensions underperformed their zero parent (0.8265676062,0.8265172085,0.8248097208 versus 0.8275704846); linear moment exceeded quadratic/copy/zero (0.8283262735 versus 0.8280653434/0.8278826252/0.8275704846). No failed-execution trials appear in this supplied lineage. This motivates a narrowly controlled representation test rather than assuming finer tokens or extra feedback always help.

study.proposed_difference: Three standalone variants, differing only in residual input selector/default. Candidate token = inherited token + A*M + B*O; duplicate = inherited token + A*M+B*M; replay = inherited token+A*M+B*0. M=W+O, so candidate is A*W+(A+B)*O and spans arbitrary separate linear maps. It introduces no new event information, tokens, task labels, loss or raw-time input. B is shared across all 35 summary tokens, bias-free 112x32, zero initialized after inherited reset inside a CPU RNG fork. All arms have 3584 additional dense parameters, analytically 32951941 total and 1158725 dense versus 32948357/1155141 for parent; these are predictions to verify on host, not measured counts. Global-relation O is analytically zero because rank coefficients center over each temporal bin. No claim of method novelty, established mechanism or local performance improvement.
predictions: Primary predeclared comparison: untied_timing validation macro AUC exceeds both duplicate_full and parent_replay under identical frozen passes; report macro Logloss and every task AUC/Logloss delta against both entry g0-r0005-linear_moment and baseline-din. Ties use the frozen policy. An isolated tiny gain is preliminary pending paired-seed repetition.

Common initial predictions agree across all three variants and with the parent; a common-state zero residual reproduces the parent at numerical tolerance. After training even empty-history predictions can change through shared learned parameters; no trained per-example equality is predicted.

On nondegenerate inputs B receives nonzero gradients in occupancy/copy arms; B receives zero gradient in the replay arm. With no matches the relation O input is zero; global O is zero, and singleton relation O=M with W=0 in exact arithmetic. These are structural diagnostics, not predictive evidence.

Exploratory existing history-length slices may localize any gain to medium/long histories; preexisting bins empty,1-16,17-64,>64 remain fixed. Prior full-vs-within favored full by about0.000449 in17-64 and0.000135 in>64, whereas1-16 slightly favored within. These outcomes motivate exploration only and are not confirmatory slice claims. Report available per-task sample/positive/negative counts and mark insufficient cells. No new slice data or feedback is assumed.
falsifiers: Untied_timing not exceeding duplicate_full leaves the claimed benefit of independent components unsupported; equality or reversal is a valid null/negative outcome. Improvement only over replay is insufficient to reject redundant-parameterization/optimization explanations.

An unstable ordering across later paired seeds or material unfavorable cost frontier weakens predictive/practical support even if the initial macro AUC improves. No undeclared task veto: report all tradeoffs.

Failed masking/current-action invariance, nonfinite outputs/gradients, incorrect label keys/shapes, violated common initialization or a zero-replay discrepancy blocks interpretation until corrected through the authorized interface with failed costs retained.

If new map has effectively zero gradients or O is zero in actual nondegenerate matched relations, a null training result diagnoses an inactive/incorrect implementation rather than refuting the hypothesis.

Fields and auxiliary labels inherit publisher snapshots and whole-window preprocessing. Equal encoded nonpadding IDs may include OOV/missing collisions. Results establish only the official_offline benchmark; production causal validity and direct advertisement conversions are unestablished.

Supplied full replay exactly matches its archived parent, so replay success is not independent mechanism evidence. No personal knowledge source exists; agent-memory searches returned no matches, which is not evidence that the mechanism is novel.
